summary: Scale one NBI birth particle's unit velocity ray by the injection speed divided by the square root of its full/half/third energy-component index, preserving the source's Float32 divisor.

identity.relation: vnbi = unit_ray * injection_speed_cm_s / sqrt(efrac) with efrac in {1, 2, 3} and the divisor evaluated as sqrt(Float32(efrac)) exactly as the source's default-REAL arithmetic.
identity.direction: unit velocity ray + injection speed + energy component index -> scaled birth velocity vector
identity.definition: The saved FIDASIM mc_nbi/mc_nbi_cell velocity scaling (framework node N2 neutral_beam_source_sampling): the full (efrac=1), half (efrac=2) and third (efrac=3) energy components carry speeds 1, 1/sqrt(2) and 1/sqrt(3) of the injection speed along the caller's unit ray. The Float32 divisor precision is a recorded source quirk, preserved verbatim and quantified in the exact document.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim with registered input hardening and a finite-output gate
identity.geometry: one birth particle; vector output in the caller's frame
identity.coordinates: velocities in cm/s; the ray is dimensionless and unit-norm
identity.boundary: finite unit-norm ray; finite positive scalar injection speed; energy component exactly the integer 1, 2 or 3 (registered hardening: bools and float 1.0 pass the source's tuple-membership test); the result must remain finite
assumptions: Non-relativistic birth kinematics; no energy spread within a component.
No external physics reference is bound beyond the source closed form.

inputs.name: unit_ray
inputs.description: Unit velocity direction of the birth particle.

inputs.name: injection_speed_cm_s
inputs.description: NBI injection speed for the full-energy component.
inputs.constraints: Finite and positive scalar (registered hardening: the source's `vinj <= 0` check lets NaN through).

inputs.name: energy_component
inputs.description: Energy component index: 1 full, 2 half, 3 third.
inputs.constraints: Exactly the integer 1, 2 or 3 (registered hardening: bools and float 1.0 pass the source's tuple-membership equality).

outputs.name: velocity_cm_s
outputs.constraints: Finite (registered hardening: raises instead of returning Inf/NaN for finite extreme inputs).

preconditions: A unit ray and positive injection speed from the caller's NBI geometry.
supported: Per-particle NBI birth velocity scaling across the three energy components.
excluded: Beam-grid position sampling, initial-state density materialization, ionization/redistribution physics, and MC weight bookkeeping.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when the ray is non-finite, not unit-norm or misshaped, when the speed is not a finite positive scalar, or when the component is not exactly the integer 1, 2 or 3.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if the scaled velocity is non-finite (registered hardening; a direct witness exists: a ray whose norm passes the 1e-12 isclose window but exceeds 1.0 multiplied by the max finite speed overflows).

example.description: Scale a unit ray for the full and third energy components; the full-energy result equals the speed times the ray, the third is shorter by sqrt(3); a NaN speed and a norm-overflowing finite ray are both rejected.
example.expected: The full-energy scaling is exact; the third component is shorter by sqrt(3) (within the Float32 divisor quirk, ~2.1 cm/s at 2e8); a NaN speed raises ValueError; a finite ray that overflows the product with the max finite speed raises ValueError (registered hardening).
